answer: Each submission hangs on the sparrow of a task receipt, and the umber is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The vine of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
